columns.collection: Parsed source collection; provisional sources stay separate.
columns.election_year: Established election year; null for undated source claims.
columns.event: General election, by-election round, or provisional source collection.
columns.office: One of the six panchayat offices.
columns.coverage_basis: Seat frame, winner/runner list, or a single-contest judgment transcription.
columns.seat_frame_rows: Known frame rows, including ambiguous source codes; null without a frame.
columns.ambiguous_seat_rows: Frame rows whose source key identifies more than one seat label.
columns.seats_with_candidates: Unambiguous frame seats with at least one candidate record.
columns.seats_with_winners: Unambiguous frame seats with a winner in the parsed winner table.
columns.seats_with_election_reservation_label: Frame rows with a nonblank election-specific source label; not independent verification.
columns.seats_with_snapshot_reservation_label: Unambiguous frame seats with a label in the undated term snapshot; not historical assignment verification.
columns.candidate_records: Published candidate rows; null when only winner/runner records are parsed.
columns.candidate_records_with_votes: Candidate rows with a nonnull vote count; observed zero counts as present.
columns.winner_records: Published winner records, which may have ambiguous seat identities.
columns.winners_source_flagged: Winner records explicitly flagged in result feeds.
columns.winners_derived: Winner records derived from votes, lots, uncontested status or sole candidacy.
columns.winner_claim_records: Rows asserted to be winners in provisional source lists; not reconciled seats.
columns.runner_name_records: Rows from a provisional runner-up list, not a complete candidate roster.
columns.records_with_reservation_label: Provisional source records with nonblank reservation text; not a unique-seat count.
columns.cross_general_election_link_status: Whether links between general-election seat frames have been established.

missing: Blank CSV numeric cells are unknown/unavailable, not zero.
limits: District Mukhiya reports include the 338 Gaya pilot PDF records, counted once here. The Khajuria judgment winner overlaps one district-report record; source totals are not additive.
A reported reservation label is not independent confirmation of its correctness.
Current-term reservations are not assigned to general or by-elections retrospectively.
Seat coverage is conditional on the collected frame, not proof of statewide completeness.
2011 winner/runner records do not establish a unique-seat frame or all-candidate coverage.
Cross-general-election links have not been established; within-term by-election membership already exists separately.
